facts.fact_text: On 3 February 2009 the first and the second applicants organised a protest demonstration in front of the Prosecutor General's Office.
When the clash between the protesters and the attackers began on 3 February 2009, no police officer intervened.
The protesters called the police and requested assistance during the attack on 3 February 2009, but received no assistance.
A police patrol appeared only one hour and a half after the attack began on 3 February 2009.

According to Article 67 of the Code of Administrative Offences, the failure by organisers of a demonstration to notify the local authorities in accordance with the provisions of the Assemblies Act of 2008 is punishable with a fine of up to 800 Moldovan Lei.
The fine of up to 800 Moldovan Lei under Article 67 of the Code of Administrative Offences was the equivalent of approximately 50 euros at the time of the events.
